$comment: Golden vectors for the loopback agent telemetry rule (ROAD-3472): contracts/rust/src/baremetal_telemetry.rs observed_state / derive_state, src/baremetal-telemetry.ts observedServingState / deriveServingState, python/apkaudio_contracts/baremetal_telemetry.py observed_state / derive_state. `observed`: what a supervisor reads a GET /telemetry answer as (document null = nothing answered). `derived`: the agent's own rule. THE RULE IS THE COUNTER, NOT THE CLAIM: zero packets is `running` whatever `state` says; only `failed` and `stub` are taken from the document.

observed.why: nothing answered: an alive PID with no telemetry is not serving
no counters is no evidence either way
a non-numeric counter is no evidence
a claim of serving with zero packets reads running
published but never received is still idle on the wire
a claim of running with packets reads serving
failed is taken from the document
stub is taken from the document, counters or not
